card.name: Space before a decimal starting with zero
card.fires_on: The space or hyphen right before a number that begins with 0 (such as 0.5, 0.01, 0.125%) in dose or strength text. The next piece is a leading zero.

modes.label: Space before decimal dose
modes.description: A space after words like 'of', 'less than', or a drug name, just before a decimal amount beginning with 0.

modes.label: Hyphen in suture size
modes.description: A hyphen inside a suture size such as 7-0.

card.writes: It promotes odd name fragments and suppresses 'zero' tokens, so it seems to stop the model writing the word zero where a digit 0 is coming.
card.plain: It fires just before a number that starts with a zero, like 0.5 mg.
